passage.title: Interview Schedule
passage.body:
面试安排

日期：2023年10月15日
时间：上午9:00
地点：上海市中心大厦10楼
请准时到达。

items.stem: What time is the interview scheduled for?
items.explanation: The text states 面试时间为 9:00 AM, which means the interview time is 9:00 AM.

items.stem: What does  午餐 (wǔcān) mean here?
items.explanation: The word  午餐 (wǔcān) is typically used to mean 'lunch'. This is confirmed by its position in the menu, which lists it after 早餐 (zǎocān, breakfast) and before 晚餐 (wǎncān, dinner).

passage.title: Drought Warning
passage.body:
农民朋友们：
本地干旱严重，请节约用水。
合理灌溉，确保丰收。
村委会

items.stem: What does the notice tell farmers to do?
choices: Ask neighbors to sell them water.
items.explanation: The notice says "节约用水", which means "ration your water usage". It does not mention buying seeds, asking neighbors, or leaving fields fallow.

passage.title: Get Vaccinated, Stay Healthy
passage.body:
疫苗接种活动

时间：2023年9月1日至9月15日

地点：市立医院

对象：18岁及以上人士

预约电话：123-4567

保持健康，从接种疫苗开始！

items.stem: What does 疫苗接种 mean in the advertisement?
items.explanation: The word 疫苗接种 in the advertisement refers to 'vaccination'. The text is about a vaccination campaign, so the context supports this meaning. The relevant phrase in the text is 疫苗接种活动 (vaccination campaign).

items.stem: Why does the advertisement mention the dates 9月1日 to 9月15日?
choices: A. To indicate when the vaccination campaign will take place
B. To show the opening hours of the clinic
C. To list the dates of other health-related events
D. To provide a schedule for doctor's appointments
items.explanation: The dates 9月1日 to 9月15日 are mentioned to indicate the duration of the vaccination campaign. The relevant phrase in the text is 9月1日至9月15日 (September 1st to September 15th), which clearly states the time frame for the 疫苗接种活动 (vaccination campaign).

passage.title: Community Center Announcement
passage.body:
社区中心公告

亲爱的居民们：

为了丰富老年人的精神生活，我们将在社区中心开设“银发俱乐部”。欢迎所有年满六十岁的老年人参加。俱乐部将提供各种活动，如书法、绘画、音乐欣赏和健身运动等。

活动时间：每周一、三、五上午九点至十一点

地点：社区中心二楼活动室

我们期待您的加入！

社区中心

2023年3月1日

items.stem: What is the age requirement for joining the 'Silver Hair Club'?
items.explanation: The text states '年满六十岁的老年人', which means 'people over 60 years old'.
